rows.question: Can an AI coding agent work with my running Compose app through hot reload? What exactly can it do there?
expected_facts: Compose Hot Reload ships an experimental MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for AI agents
The agent can trigger reloads and take screenshots
It can inspect the semantic tree and simulate clicks and text input
It can read the application logs

run.answer: Yes, an AI coding agent can work with a running Compose app through hot reload using the experimental Model Context Protocol (MCP) server [c1]. Using this server, an agent can trigger reloads, take screenshots, inspect the semantic tree, simulate clicks and text input, and read application logs [c2]. In practice, this means the agent can verify the results of its own edits [c3]. It can confirm that the reload succeeded, inspect the rendered UI, catch a runtime exception, and iterate – all without you describing what’s on screen [c4].
